hero.title: Let's get acquainted
hero.description: Behind Le Sourire is a caring team and an attentive practitioner, committed to gentle, lasting treatment.

intro.name: Dr. Amine Belkacem
intro.p1: Based in the heart of Algiers, Dr. Amine Belkacem has cared for patients of all ages for over fifteen years. His belief: successful care starts with a relationship of trust, taking the time to listen and explain.
intro.p2: Trained in the latest techniques, he puts prevention and comfort at the centre of his practice, so every visit runs smoothly — from the youngest to the most anxious patients.
highlights: Ongoing training in implantology and aesthetics
